message: This isn't me talking: it's my AI clone, made from one minute of video. Here's how, and where to learn the whole setup.

lines.text: This isn't me talking. It's my AI clone, and I made it from one minute of video.
Film yourself talking straight to the camera for one minute, in good light.
Upload it to HeyGen, and it builds an avatar that moves the way you do.
Clone your voice in ElevenLabs, then type any line and your clone says it.
Now I post videos without filming. If you want to learn, step by step, how to clone yourself, join my Skool community.
